title: [review] lichend.rs: Concentrator init failures silently ignored
description: Both conc.reset() and conc.configure() results are discarded with `let _`. If hardware initialization fails, the daemon continues with an unconfigured concentrator, leading to silent RF failures. The HAT mode should fail fast or at minimum log the error.
close_reason: Fixed: Concentrator reset() and configure() now check results and abort HAT mode with error log if initialization fails, preventing silent RF failures from unconfigured hardware
